description: Bring 6, choose 4, two leads (`maxChosenTeamSize: 4`, doubles). The engine requires exactly 6 registered Pokémon (`Min Team Size = 6` in the champions `Flat Rules`); the VGC Tournament Handbook §2.1 allows 4 to 6 by event format, and the in-game Ranked team size is unverified (format matrix U3). Areneon runs 6-Pokémon teams only.
